compute_nvemd_energy_drift: compute the total energy drift in meV/atom/ps from an NVE MD trajectory file
calculate_moving_average: calculate a moving average of a numpy array with a configurable window size
join_nvemd_results: join total energy drift results from multiple NVE MD trajectory files into a list
save_nvemd_results: save NVE MD drift results to a text file in the results directory
compute_nvemd_metrics: compute mean drift metrics from NVE MD results and return as a pandas DataFrame
